We allocate most of the budget to unrolled_k, with a small iterative share to document infeasibility. Accuracy needs N>=12 and W>=14; we search around these minima to find the lowest-power feasible designs. This round uses 60 evals (51 unrolled_k, 9 iterative), reserving 40 for refinement and final front mapping.
